title: Route path diagram
acceptance: Hand-authored inline SVG with a viewBox and no fixed width/height; no charting library.
The serving node is unmistakable by shape and weight, not by colour alone.
Remaining fallbacks render as provisional, never as though traffic reaches them.
The no-eligible-candidate case has its own deliberate terminal rendering.
A visually hidden ordered list mirrors the diagram, and tab order follows walk order.
Layout solver, serving-index resolver, and aria-label generator are exported pure functions with tests covering empty, single, none-eligible, and orientation-switch cases.
